system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Harmonic Branch]

You have developed an album of songs meant to bring ruin to your foes, but victory to you and your allies. These songs are known as your Harmonies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Harmonies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.

If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.

Pull The Strings

Once per turn, when a Kashu clan Hijutsu you cast would affect a creature with ranks of a Mental Condition, on a failure, they become overwhelmed with a strong drive to approach the source of your song, even if detrimental. They spend their reaction to move up to their speed towards you. This movement can trigger attacks of opportunity.

Binding Melody

Doki you control gain the Binding Melody ability.

Binding Melody. While mute, this Doki begins to jump, bounce and move in a rhythmic fashion. All hostile creatures within 10 feet of the Doki must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they suffer the curse of Binding, gaining 1 rank of Sealed, and being unable to target creatures other this Doki until the end of their next turn. Ranks of Sealed increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Rhythmic Repeat

Once per turn, when a creature with ranks of Disorientation takes damage from a source other than you or a Doki you control, you deal an additional 1d6 psychic damage to them, per rank of Disorientation, as their ear drums vibrates violently in response. This is treated as conditional damage.

Echo Chamber

When you cast a Kashu clan Hijutsu, you can have it originate from up to two active Doki you have instead of yourself. If you do, creatures can only be affected by one instance of the chosen jutsu at once.

Aggressive Tempo

When you cast a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, if an allied creature is in the jutsu’s range, they become immune to its hostile effects, and also gain a +10 bonus to their speed, and a +2 bonus to damage they deal as a result of jutsu they cast until the end of their next turn. Their bonus to speed increases to +20 at 7th and +30 at 15th levels. And their bonus to damage increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th levels.

Underworlds Melody

As an Action, you release a regenerative song, healing all Doki within 15 feet of you by 4d6 hit points. This increases to 6d6 at 7th and 8d6 at 15th levels. Doki can only be affected by this song, twice per combat.

Demonic Chorus

Kashu Genjutsu you cast, increase their damage by +2 for every active Doki you have as their overlapping demonic resonance amplifies your illusory output.

Harmonious Bridge

Once per turn, when a Doki scores a hit on a creature, you can immediately command it or another Doki to use their Revolt of the Demon World attack against the same creature.
